headline: Approved FY27 revised general fund budget of $65,421,429 and five-year capital plan; rejected My School Bucks contract 0-6.
summary: The School Committee approved the consent agenda, accepted the Superintendent's report, and approved a fundraiser allowing the Athletic Director to approve individual team concessions. It approved a FY27 capital improvement five-year plan, a fund transfer of $1,003,292 for capital projects, and a revised FY27 general fund budget of $65,421,429, but rejected a proposed My School Bucks service fee contract by a 0-6 vote. The Superintendent's renewal contract and a discussion on data-based decisions were tabled for future meetings.
decisions: Approved the Consent Agenda, including minutes, purchase orders over $10,350, homeschool requests, and a Robotics Club fundraiser.
Accepted the Superintendent's Report as presented.
Approved a fundraiser allowing the Athletic Director to approve individual team concession stands.
Tabled approval of the Superintendent's renewal contract for a future meeting.
Rejected the School Lunch Program contract for My School Bucks service fee due to new state law limitations, 0-6.
Approved the recommended Five-Year Capital Improvement Plan, 5-0.
Approved a fund transfer from the General Fund to Capital Improvement of $1,003,292 and use of a $532,494 housing pass-through from the Town.
Approved the FY27 Revised General Fund Budget of $65,421,429 with amendments, including a $490,000 expense adjustment.
Accepted the FY27 Monthly Year-to-Date Budget to Actual Fiscal Report.
Tabled discussion of School Committee Goal #4 on Making Data-Based Decisions for a later meeting.
